```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 设置报告运行环境，并加载流程共用函数。
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("snRNAseq_publication_pipeline", "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# 检查并加载脾脏聚类、SingleR 注释和绘图所需包。
check_packages(c(
  "Seurat", "SeuratObject", "SingleR", "celldex", "scuttle",
  "BiocParallel", "harmony", "dplyr", "ggplot2",
  "patchwork", "future", "glmGamPoi", "here"
))

library(Seurat)
library(SingleR)
library(celldex)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(harmony)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(future)

if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)
  RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1)
}

# Seurat uses the future backend in expensive steps such as SCTransform.
plan("multicore", workers = 6)
options(future.fork.enable = TRUE)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 88 * 1024^3)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths()
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "01_Spleen_Annotation"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "01_Spleen_Annotation"))

# 默认不使用样本或 mouse 作为 Harmony batch；主聚类和子聚类使用不同 PCA 维度。
harmony_batch_var <- NULL
dims_main <- 1:30
dims_subset <- 1:20
```

## Load spleen object

```{r load}
# 读取 00 步骤输出的脾脏 QC 后对象。
sc_spleen <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "00_spleen_qc.rds"))
sc_spleen$Group <- normalize_group_levels(sc_spleen$Group)
message("Spleen cells after QC: ", ncol(sc_spleen))
```

## Main clustering without sample-level Harmony

```{r main_clustering}
# 对全部脾脏细胞执行 SCTransform、PCA、邻居图、聚类和 UMAP。
sc_spleen <- run_sctransform_embedding(
  sc_spleen,
  dims = dims_main,
  resolution = 0.6,
  harmony_batch_var = harmony_batch_var
)

p_clusters <- DimPlot(sc_spleen, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Spleen clusters")
print(p_clusters)
# 保存主聚类 UMAP，供后续检查聚类结构。
save_pub_plot(p_clusters, "01_spleen_umap_clusters", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)
```

## SingleR main annotation

```{r singler}
# 使用 ImmGen 参考集对脾脏细胞做 SingleR 主类别注释。
ref_immgen <- celldex::ImmGenData()
sc_spleen <- run_singler_main(sc_spleen, ref_immgen, workers = 6)
sc_spleen$CellType_Fine <- sc_spleen$CellType_Main

p_main <- DimPlot(sc_spleen, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Main", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Spleen main annotation")
print(p_main)
save_pub_plot(p_main, "01_spleen_umap_main_annotation", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 6)

main_table <- sc_spleen@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Main, name = "Cells")
# 输出主类别在每只 mouse 中的细胞数。
write.csv(main_table, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_main_annotation_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Refine B-cell compartment

```{r bcell_refinement}
# 根据 SingleR/主注释筛选 B 细胞相关标签，进入 B-cell compartment 精细聚类。
b_labels <- grep("B cells|B cell|B lymph", unique(c(sc_spleen$CellType_SingleR_Raw, sc_spleen$CellType_Main)), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
b_cells_keep <- rownames(sc_spleen@meta.data)[sc_spleen$CellType_SingleR_Raw %in% b_labels | sc_spleen$CellType_Main %in% b_labels]
if (length(b_cells_keep) < 100) stop("Too few spleen B-lineage cells for refinement. Check SingleR labels.")

b_cells <- subset(sc_spleen, cells = b_cells_keep)
DefaultAssay(b_cells) <- "RNA"
b_cells <- run_sctransform_embedding(
  b_cells,
  dims = dims_subset,
  resolution = 0.3,
  harmony_batch_var = harmony_batch_var
)

b_map_path <- file.path(paths$map_dir, "spleen_bcell_manual_map.csv")
b_template_path <- file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_bcell_annotation_template_current_clusters.csv")
# 写出当前 B 细胞聚类模板，并检查手动注释表是否覆盖所有 cluster。
write_annotation_template(b_cells, b_map_path, b_template_path)
b_map_check <- validate_annotation_map(b_cells, b_map_path)
if (!isTRUE(b_map_check$ok)) {
  stop(
    "Spleen B-cell manual annotation map does not match current clustering. ",
    "Review marker plots/tables and update: ", b_map_path, ". ",
    "Current template written to: ", b_template_path, ". ",
    "Missing clusters: ", paste(b_map_check$missing_clusters, collapse = ","), ". ",
    "Blank labels: ", paste(b_map_check$blank_labels, collapse = ","),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
b_cells <- apply_manual_annotation(b_cells, b_map_check$map, unknown_label = "Unknown spleen B cluster")

# B 细胞 marker panel 用于验证手动 fine label 是否符合已知 marker 表达。
spleen_b_markers <- c(
  "Cd19", "Ms4a1", "Cd79a", "Ighd", "Ighm", "Fas", "Bcl6", "Aicda",
  "Mki67", "Jchain", "Irf4", "Prdm1", "Sdc1", "Ighg1", "Cd80"
)

p_b_clusters <- DimPlot(b_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Spleen B-lineage subclusters")
p_b_anno <- DimPlot(b_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Fine", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Spleen B-lineage manual annotation")
p_b_dot <- make_marker_dotplot(b_cells, spleen_b_markers, group.by = "CellType_Fine", title = "Spleen B-lineage marker validation")

print(p_b_clusters)
print(p_b_anno)
print(p_b_dot)

save_pub_plot(p_b_clusters, "01_spleen_bcell_umap_clusters", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)
save_pub_plot(p_b_anno, "01_spleen_bcell_umap_manual_annotation", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 6)
save_pub_plot(p_b_dot, "01_spleen_bcell_marker_dotplot", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)

# 同时按 cluster 和最终 fine label 输出 marker 表达验证表。
b_validation_cluster <- marker_validation_table(b_cells, spleen_b_markers, group_col = "seurat_clusters")
b_validation_fine <- marker_validation_table(b_cells, spleen_b_markers, group_col = "CellType_Fine")
write.csv(b_validation_cluster, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_bcell_marker_validation_by_cluster.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(b_validation_fine, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_bcell_marker_validation_by_fine_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Refine T-cell compartment

```{r tcell_refinement}
# 根据 SingleR/主注释筛选 T 细胞相关标签，进入 T-cell compartment 精细聚类。
t_labels <- grep("T cells|T cell|T lymph", unique(c(sc_spleen$CellType_SingleR_Raw, sc_spleen$CellType_Main)), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
t_cells_keep <- rownames(sc_spleen@meta.data)[sc_spleen$CellType_SingleR_Raw %in% t_labels | sc_spleen$CellType_Main %in% t_labels]
if (length(t_cells_keep) < 100) stop("Too few spleen T-lineage cells for refinement. Check SingleR labels.")

t_cells <- subset(sc_spleen, cells = t_cells_keep)
DefaultAssay(t_cells) <- "RNA"
t_cells <- run_sctransform_embedding(
  t_cells,
  dims = dims_subset,
  resolution = 0.3,
  harmony_batch_var = harmony_batch_var
)

t_map_path <- file.path(paths$map_dir, "spleen_tcell_manual_map.csv")
t_template_path <- file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_tcell_annotation_template_current_clusters.csv")
# 写出当前 T 细胞聚类模板，并检查手动注释表是否覆盖所有 cluster。
write_annotation_template(t_cells, t_map_path, t_template_path)
t_map_check <- validate_annotation_map(t_cells, t_map_path)
if (!isTRUE(t_map_check$ok)) {
  stop(
    "Spleen T-cell manual annotation map does not match current clustering. ",
    "Review marker plots/tables and update: ", t_map_path, ". ",
    "Current template written to: ", t_template_path, ". ",
    "Missing clusters: ", paste(t_map_check$missing_clusters, collapse = ","), ". ",
    "Blank labels: ", paste(t_map_check$blank_labels, collapse = ","),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
t_cells <- apply_manual_annotation(t_cells, t_map_check$map, unknown_label = "Unknown spleen T cluster")

# T 细胞 marker panel 用于区分 naive、memory、Tfh、Treg 和 cytotoxic T 等状态。
spleen_t_markers <- c(
  "Cd3d", "Cd3e", "Cd4", "Cd8a", "Sell", "Ccr7", "Cd44",
  "Cxcr5", "Bcl6", "Icos", "Pdcd1", "Gzmb", "Prf1",
  "Ifng", "Tbx21", "Foxp3", "Il2ra", "Ctla4"
)

p_t_clusters <- DimPlot(t_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Spleen T-cell subclusters")
p_t_anno <- DimPlot(t_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Fine", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Spleen T-cell manual annotation")
p_t_dot <- make_marker_dotplot(t_cells, spleen_t_markers, group.by = "CellType_Fine", title = "Spleen T-cell marker validation")

print(p_t_clusters)
print(p_t_anno)
print(p_t_dot)

save_pub_plot(p_t_clusters, "01_spleen_tcell_umap_clusters", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)
save_pub_plot(p_t_anno, "01_spleen_tcell_umap_manual_annotation", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 6)
save_pub_plot(p_t_dot, "01_spleen_tcell_marker_dotplot", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)

# 同时按 cluster 和最终 fine label 输出 marker 表达验证表。
t_validation_cluster <- marker_validation_table(t_cells, spleen_t_markers, group_col = "seurat_clusters")
t_validation_fine <- marker_validation_table(t_cells, spleen_t_markers, group_col = "CellType_Fine")
write.csv(t_validation_cluster, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_tcell_marker_validation_by_cluster.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(t_validation_fine, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_tcell_marker_validation_by_fine_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Merge refined labels back to spleen

```{r merge_back}
# 将 B/T 子聚类的精细标签写回完整脾脏对象。
sc_spleen$CellType_Fine <- sc_spleen$CellType_Main
sc_spleen$CellType_Fine[colnames(b_cells)] <- b_cells$CellType_Fine
sc_spleen$CellType_Fine[colnames(t_cells)] <- t_cells$CellType_Fine

p_fine <- DimPlot(sc_spleen, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Fine", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Spleen fine annotation")
print(p_fine)
save_pub_plot(p_fine, "01_spleen_umap_fine_annotation", fig_dir, width = 12, height = 6)

fine_table <- sc_spleen@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Fine, name = "Cells")
# 保存最终 fine annotation 计数和后续步骤使用的 RDS 对象。
write.csv(fine_table, file.path(table_dir, "01_spleen_fine_annotation_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(sc_spleen, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(b_cells, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_bcells_refined.rds"))
saveRDS(t_cells, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_tcells_refined.rds"))
```
